design_philosophy: Apple-style premium tech hardware. High contrast, dark mode dominant to make LED displays pop, utilizing 'Crystal Glass' (Glassmorphism) for surfaces to signify modern, high-end engineering. Focus on UI consistency, rigorous grid alignments, and concise, high-impact copy.

headings.rules: Never use Inter for headings. Keep H1 strictly under 5 words (e.g., 'Brilliant Displays. Infinite Possibilities.'). No verbose text in hero. Use tracking-tight (-0.02em to -0.04em).

body.rules: Use text-zinc-300 for readable paragraphs. High contrast text-white for primary data.

colors.rules: Do not use generic blue. For buttons, use glassmorphic layers instead of flat solid colors. Accent colors should be used for subtle glows or active states, mimicking LED lights.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use 'Crystal Glass' variant: backdrop-blur-xl or backdrop-blur-2xl with bg-white/5 and border border-white/10. Add a subtle shadow: shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.5)].
visual_enhancers.ambient_glow: For hero product images, place a div behind the image with absolute positioning, blur-3xl, and an accent color (e.g., bg-cyan-500/20) to simulate LED glow.
visual_enhancers.buttons: Apple-style pill buttons: rounded-full, backdrop-blur-lg, bg-white/10, border border-white/20, text-white, transition-all duration-300, hover:bg-white/20 hover:scale-105 active:scale-95.

layouts.hero: Short heading (H1), minimal subtext, large centered or asymmetrical 3D/HD LED image with ambient glow. Generous padding (py-24 to py-32).
layouts.product_cards: Must be uniform! Use `flex flex-col h-full bg-white/5 border border-white/10 backdrop-blur-md rounded-2xl overflow-hidden`. Image must have `aspect-[4/3] w-full object-cover`. Content wrapper gets `p-6 flex flex-col flex-grow`. Button/footer gets `mt-auto` to push to bottom and perfectly align all cards in the grid.
layouts.product_detail_page: Split layout: Sticky gallery on left (`md:sticky md:top-24`), rich SEO-optimized content on right. Use Accordions for technical specs. Add a 'Related Products' grid at the bottom for internal linking.
layouts.spacing: Use p-6 or p-8 inside cards. gap-6 or gap-8 for grids. Sections should have py-24 for breathing room.

components.Header: Sticky header with backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/50 border-b border-white/10. Must not be fully transparent.
components.ProductCard: Standardized height via flex-col + flex-grow + mt-auto. Fixed image aspect ratio.
components.Buttons: Glassmorphic pill-shaped buttons. Avoid flat Vercel/Stripe styles.
components.SEO_ContentBlock: Rich text area utilizing semantic HTML (h2, h3, p, ul) with keyword-rich content. Include schema.org structured data in a hidden script tag if applicable.

motion.hover: Subtle lifts (-translate-y-1) and brightness increases on cards.
motion.transitions: Use specific transitions: `transition-[transform,background-color,border-color] duration-300 ease-out`. Never use `transition-all` on structural elements.
motion.entrance: Staggered fade-up for product grids using framer-motion.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over glassmorphism has sufficient APCA contrast. Use text-shadow if necessary.
accessibility.images: CRITICAL: Every image MUST have descriptive SEO-rich `alt` text. Not just 'product', but 'Outdoor 4K LED Display Panel for Concerts'.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., data-testid='add-to-cart-btn').

Close up of an LED panel with glowing light patterns

instructions_to_main_agent: Fix Hero Copy: Replace long, verbose headings like 'LED DISPPLAY & etc' with short, 3-5 word high-impact H1s. Move secondary info to a smaller, readable sub-headline.

Fix Product Cards: Implement the equal-height layout exactly. Container: `flex flex-col h-full`. Image: `aspect-[4/3] object-cover`. Content: `flex-grow`. Button/Footer: `mt-auto`. This natively solves the uneven sizing.
Apply Glassmorphism universally: Remove flat opaque buttons. Replace with `backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/10 border border-white/20 rounded-full` Apple-style buttons across all pages.

Boost SEO & Content: On the 333 SEO routes/PDPs, do not leave descriptions short. Generate long-form, detailed feature descriptions utilizing semantic HTML. Include rich internal linking ('Explore our Transparent LED range').
Alt Tags: Inject highly descriptive, keyword-rich alt tags on all product images.
Component Strategy: Use raw HTML/Tailwind for the marketing layouts and Shadcn customized for forms/inputs. Ensure no generic 'Vercel' look remains.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN. Always use valid image URLs.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute.
